title: Future: JMAP Photo/Album companion spec
description: FileNode provides a generic file tree with thumbnails but no photo-specific semantics. A photo library needs: Album type (named collection with ordering and cover image), photo metadata (EXIF, GPS, camera model, date taken), gallery views, shared album permissions, and face/object tagging. Could be a companion spec (draft-atwood-jmap-photo-00) layered on top of FileNode blobs. Not urgent — note for future exploration.
